objections.text: The hand-derived fixed cases already test a lowercase province code joining 'US' under CI_AS and a province code with a trailing space joining 'US'. Using additional mixed-case spellings and combining case with the trailing space attacks the same two join mechanisms.
objections.resolution: A01 now uses non-ASCII Latin-1 and Greek case pairs and places the combined case/trailing-space difference on the country side. Those inputs exercise case folding beyond ASCII and asymmetric trimming paths not covered by the hand-derived cases.

objections.text: A09 inserts the identical PersonPhone primary-key tuple (BusinessEntityID 1, PhoneNumber '555-0100', PhoneNumberTypeID 1) twice. That duplicate cannot occur under the source schema preconditions.
objections.resolution: A09 now sends the same number under two distinct PhoneNumberTypeID values. The PersonPhone primary-key tuples are distinct while the equal type names still produce identical projected rows.
